summary: Gorax announces his participation in the Eve of the Rift / Riftbound All-Star Night web event, choosing the Dark Lady faction. He invites viewers to join using his creator link to select him as their God's Envoy. By participating, players earn lottery tickets to spin the reward wheel for prizes including physical figurines of The Dark Lady and Sagomir, dice, art books, and merch.
tips: Join the Riftbound All-Star Night web event via the creator's link and support The Dark Lady faction to receive lottery tickets for reward draws.
title: Pick GORAX as Your God's Envoy! | Faction War | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
